attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 6 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives no year. The corpus's two other men of this name are Epimachus on 9 May and Epimachus of Pelusium on 31 October, and neither is on this day. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
